ai_actions.description: Run the Doxa/Visual capture health probe and return structured results.
Re-enumerate the expected Doxa hardware and display functions.
Repeat the bounded post-install Doxa health check.
Collect the approved structured installation/support evidence bundle.
Stop local remediation and return a machine-readable enterprise IT escalation.

note: Version 1 deliberately gives the AI only diagnostic/escalation actions. Mutating installation actions remain deterministic local code.
